summary: Iter-30 sprint validated end-to-end. Running from /app/backend/ works. Not a product bug, a cwd-sensitivity artifact of sqlite:///./ifpi_lms.db in DATABASE_URL.

minor.issue: run_streak_digest_pass() opens SQLite via SessionLocal which honours cwd because DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./ifpi_lms.db — running pytest from /app instead of /app/backend targets a stale /app/ifpi_lms.db that lacks marketplace_opt_in column. Cosmetic — tests pass when run from /app/backend as documented in project conventions.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: normalise DATABASE_URL to an absolute path (sqlite:////app/backend/ifpi_lms.db) so pytest works from any cwd — currently the sqlite:///./ifpi_lms.db relative path silently spawns a fresh empty DB when pytest runs from /app root. All existing tests already run from /app/backend so this is only a paper-cut for new agents.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCertificatesPage.tsx — Clean single-file (~305 lines) implementation. Uses TanStack Query for list + revocation-history caching (invalidateQueries on bulk revoke). All data-testids match the spec. Uses useConfirm() for the bulk-revoke confirmation dialog (variant='danger', correct label with count). window.prompt for reason capture is intentional per task note — cancel returns null and short-circuits. CSV export uses api.get with responseType:'blob' + createObjectURL + auto-click download link, then revokes URL. Line 100 has an unused base URL fallback assignment — harmless, could be dropped.

routers/misc.py — Route ordering fix (/admin-list, /admin-export.csv, /bulk-revoke as single-segment paths) correctly avoids FastAPI matching them as {cert_id}='admin'/'bulk'. Bulk-revoke returns granular per-item status (already_revoked / forbidden / not_found / revoked) which matches the spec exactly.

CertificateRevocationEvent model — Populated on both revoke and unrevoke; hydrated actor_name + actor_email in GET /revocation-history via a User join. Sorted reverse-chronological. Admin-only gate returns 403 for LEARNER (verified). Frontend drawer handles empty-state via 'history-empty' testid.

Cert revocation webhook — WebhookDelivery row is created when a webhook subscription with events=['certificate.revoked'] exists at the time of revoke. Verified by creating a sub, revoking, then GET /webhooks/{sub_id}/deliveries. Test passes.

streak_digest_worker.run_streak_digest_pass() — Scans orgs, computes top 5 streaks, queues 'streak_digest' template emails to ADMIN/INSTRUCTOR members. Idempotent by design (last_sent_at guard). Test verifies orgs_scanned>=1 and emails_queued>=0.

ci_typecheck.sh — Runs yarn typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and exits 0 on clean tree; validated as an assertion inside test_frontend_typecheck_passes. This is the safety net promised after the iter-29 ImportsPage.tsx black-screen incident.

window.confirm audit — Zero raw window.confirm( calls remain in /app/frontend/src (test_no_window_confirm_calls_left passes). The only window.prompt( in the tree is the intentional reason-input in AdminCertificatesPage bulkRevoke — this is documented in the task and not a regression.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-30 sprint certified green with ZERO product changes needed. Key facts to preserve: (1) When running pytest, ALWAYS cd /app/backend first — SQLite path in DATABASE_URL is relative (./ifpi_lms.db) and running from /app root points to a stale 962KB fixture DB with pre-marketplace_opt_in schema. (2) AdminCertificatesPage bulk-revoke uses window.prompt to capture the reason text BEFORE the useConfirm dialog opens — this is INTENTIONAL, documented, and NOT a regression of the window.confirm sweep. Only window.confirm( calls are banned, window.prompt( is allowed. (3) Learner admin@ifpi.org (sic — that should read learner@ifpi.org) has 48 certs now (was 43 after iter-29). Fresh certs are named TEST_iter27_* and TEST_iter28_* (attendance) from previous test runs. (4) Backend routes are single-segment: /admin-list, /admin-export.csv, /bulk-revoke, /{id}/revocation-history — do NOT rewrite as /admin/list etc, FastAPI would match /admin as {cert_id}. (5) Bearer-token auth via /api/auth/login access_token returns 401 on downstream endpoints — the platform uses httpOnly cookies as the primary auth (CSRF-protected). Use requests.Session and let cookies flow, or Authorization header ONLY works in certain code paths.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs discovered. Only observation: initial pytest run from /app root failed test_streak_digest_worker_queues_emails with 'no such column: organizations.marketplace_opt_in'. Root cause: DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./ifpi_lms.db resolves relative to cwd; a stale /app/ifpi_lms.db (from an earlier test run before the marketplace migration existed) sat in the repo root. When pytest launches the in-process worker (as opposed to hitting the running backend), SessionLocal binds to that stale DB. Fix: cd /app/backend before running pytest, which the project's standing convention already documents. Optional hardening: convert to absolute sqlite path or use os.path.join(BACKEND_DIR, 'ifpi_lms.db') in core/database.py. Not blocking — 11/11 tests pass when run from the correct cwd.
